In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of hybrid online social systems that have a positive impact on the individuals and communities they serve.
understanding the design of hybrid social systems and the role of institutions, norms and organisations in that design.
the conscientious design of hybrid online social systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the design, construction and operation of hybrid online social systems should consider and address the following: (1) The psychological and sociological impacts of such systems on the individual, (2) The social and organisational implications of such systems for communities and institutions, (3) The ethical implications of such systems on society.

we need to be aware of the impact of the design of online systems on the human and social aspects of the systems and to be aware of how the systems are being used by the humans and social aspects of them.
we should design online social systems with the intention of making them as beneficial to society as possible, while at the same time avoiding any negative impact.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
online social systems have the potential of becoming an important part of our society and that we have to be aware of their impact on our society.

we are trying to make sense of the social impact of online social systems and to develop methods for designing such systems in a way that their social impact can be predicted, understood and controlled.
online hybrid social systems have the potential to change the way we interact, the way we think and the way we act.
The main takeaway from our work is that
online social systems are not just technical systems, they are social systems that need to be designed with care, taking into consideration the social impact they will have.
the design of online systems needs to take account of human and artificial agency in order to achieve a more balanced and sustainable social impact of these systems.
hybrid social systems are a new kind of socio-technical system that we have to learn to understand and to design, and for that we need new methods and tools.
